customer: Hello, I recently relocated to Virginia and I'm hoping to sell my cargo van, but I can't seem to find a paper title anywhere among my moving boxes. Could you tell me how I'd go about getting a replacement before I come in? Thank you so much for your help.
agent: Thank you for reaching out, and welcome to the area! Virginia uses electronic titles, so there's usually no paper title to lose, but if you'd like a printed copy you can request a duplicate title online from the Virginia motor vehicle agency, and it typically arrives in about a week. Please bring either the printout or the confirmation email to your appointment, and you can find more details in our article "Getting a duplicate title in Virginia."
